description.plain: This handwoven indoor/outdoor rug features a contemporary yet transitional style with a textured chevron design in marled blue and ecru. Crafted from durable, performance polyester yarns, it is designed to be sun-, rain-, dog-, and child-proof, making it ideal for open-air living. The flatweave construction offers a classic herringbone rhythm, and the material is hosed-down and scrubbable for easy maintenance.

description.plain: This luxurious and intuitive moisturizer from U Beauty deeply hydrates and resolves compromised barrier function where skin is most parched. Powered by U Beauty's proprietary HYDRA-SIREN Capsule, it effectively transports water to the deeper layers of the skin. Advanced hydration is immediate, while the five unique types of hyaluronic acid continue to hydrate throughout the day. SIRENS neutralize free radicals as they arise, expediting visible skin repair. Anti-aging ingredients provide a radiant glow, resulting in groundbreaking, long-lasting hydration. It is clean, hypoallergenic, cruelty-free, gluten-free, and non-GMO. Tested for safe use on all skin types and tones, and around the eyes. Dermatologically tested for sensitivity. Made in Italy.

description.plain: The Rose Inc Radiant Reveal Brightening Serum is a powerful hydrating serum designed to instantly brighten the complexion and reveal healthy-looking skin without clogging pores. Its lightweight, fast-absorbing formula contains a blend of Squalane to soothe and moisturize, sea fennel extract to encourage luminosity, and Vitamin C to combat dullness and provide antioxidant protection. It is suitable for all skin types and specifically targets dryness, dullness, and a weak skin barrier, leaving the skin plumped and with a more even tone.
